verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe named public APIs covering the core platform operations: the Legal Entity Management API for onboarding, the Configuration API for balance accounts, split instructions on payment endpoints, and a fully API-only onboarding path. Webhooks, HMAC signature verification and test credentials support automated, programmatic workflows. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found at the probed paths, no evidence on server-side API authentication, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
